name: Agent Stops Working
description: Flow when an agent completes work - blinds animate up and state is removed from store

scenarios.description: Agent completes work, blinds animate up, state removed from store and broadcast to all windows

template.introduction:
**Agent Stopped Working**

Session `{{session.id}}` in window {{window.id}} has completed work. The blinds overlay has been dismissed and all windows have been notified.

    Blinds animating up (closing)

    Session: `{{session.id}}`, Working: {{is_working}}
